scope: Existing neural inverse SLS ensemble with bounded physical refinement applied to synthetic category-dependent design histories for all soft scene structures. Not organ-specific biological training, clinical calibration, or validated whole-body tissue mechanics.
density_provenance: Fixed 1000 kg/m^3 display-simulation assumption, not learned.
parameter_intervals_scope: Synthetic inverse-model calibration only; does not measure human tissue uncertainty.
skeleton_scope: Rib cage, spine and pelvis are rigid supports and have no soft material assigned.
inference_method: Protocol-conditioned neural ensemble proposal followed by bounded robust physical refinement.

held_out_validation.protocol: New smooth half-sine-squared strain history, distinct from fitting ramp-hold-release history

diagnostics.ood_scope: Checks excitation support, fitted bounds, residual mismatch and local sensitivity; does not detect every biological model mismatch.
